intro: Pick up orders, ride through the city, and become the ultimate bike courier.
description:
Every delivery counts!

Jump on your bike and experience the life of a city courier in a vibrant open-world delivery adventure. Pick up food, drinks, and packages from local businesses and race through busy streets to deliver orders on time while building your reputation as the city's most trusted rider.

Explore a large city filled with unique districts, from bustling residential neighborhoods and lively parks to industrial zones packed with shortcuts and hidden routes. Watch the city come alive through a dynamic day-and-night cycle and changing weather conditions that make every delivery feel different.

Manage your stamina during long rides and collect energy sodas scattered throughout the city to keep moving when the pressure is on. Earn money from successful deliveries and unlock up to 12 unique bicycles, each offering its own riding style, speed, handling, and performance.

Looking for extra challenges? Practice wheelies and show off your bike-handling skills while exploring every corner of the city.

Whether you prefer relaxing rides through the streets or racing against the clock to complete deliveries, Bike Food Delivery Simulator offers a fun and rewarding courier experience for players of all ages.

Features
Explore a large open-world city
Deliver food, drinks, and packages across multiple districts
Dynamic day-and-night cycle and weather system
City traffic that creates new challenges for every route
Unlock and ride 12 unique bicycles
Earn money and expand your delivery career
Stamina system with collectible energy boosts
Perform wheelies and improve your riding skills
Discover residential areas, parks, industrial zones, and hidden shortcuts
Relaxing and accessible simulation gameplay

Grab your bike, hit the streets, and become the ultimate city delivery rider!
